product.visualSummary: A two-piece magnetic umbrella holder: a separate upper piece and lower piece that attach with magnets to a compatible steel surface such as a steel front door; it holds both long and folding umbrellas; available in dark gray, gray or white.

beats: Jack confidently refuses to carry an umbrella in Seoul.
A bus roof leaks, a storm drain erupts, and Jack struggles through exaggerated flooding.
Jack reaches their hilltop home completely soaked.
Diane refuses to let him drip water inside and throws him a towel.
Diane sees an opportunity to buy a magnetic umbrella holder on Coupang.
Diane excitedly shows Jack her purchase.
Jack lovingly praises her but still refuses to use an umbrella.

scenes.title: Jack refuses the umbrella
scenes.visual: Seoul street, grey sky. Jack strides past a convenience store umbrella rack, shakes his head with a smug, dry smile.

scenes.title: The absurd monsoon begins
scenes.visual: The sky cracks open. Cartoonishly huge raindrops hammer the street; Jack's smile freezes.

scenes.title: Bus leak, storm drain, flood
scenes.visual: Inside a bus the roof leaks on Jack; outside a storm drain erupts like a fountain and exaggerated flood water sweeps the street. Obvious comedic exaggeration, not documentary.

scenes.title: Soaked at the hilltop home
scenes.visual: Jack trudges up the hill and reaches the front door of their home, completely soaked, hair plastered down.

scenes.title: Diane throws the towel
scenes.visual: Diane blocks the doorway with a hand up, refusing to let him drip inside, then throws a towel that lands on his head.

scenes.title: Diane spots the shopping excuse
scenes.visual: Diane's eyes light up as she scrolls Coupang on her phone and taps order on a magnetic umbrella holder.

scenes.title: BABYYYY! Look what I got
scenes.visual: Diane proudly points to the two-piece magnetic umbrella holder attached to the steel front door; Jack, towel on shoulders, looks at it.

scenes.title: Jack still refuses
scenes.visual: Jack praises her warmly with a thumbs-up, then dryly walks off without an umbrella; Diane throws her hands up in mock outrage.

suggestions.speaker: jack
suggestions.en: I'm British. We don't need umbrellas.
